fusions.name: Brood Stingers
fusions.desc: Sends 3 hatchlings out in a spread out to 7 tiles, each of which deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbed Parting
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A sting left in the wound, which deals 9 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Egg-Sac Hive
fusions.desc: Splits an egg sac. For 12 seconds its hatchlings swarm an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, and each kill restores 4 health to you.

fusions.name: Tireless Spinner
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you regain 6 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
